validation.fixture_scope: Portable C/RV32 owner and logical memory fixture. RX/PKT state uses their portable APIs. Original native DESC10 instructions, allocator/caller transport and locks are not replayed.
validation.normal_raw: Two independent current-source pair builds are byte-identical to the previous CODE/DATA; all16 image groups pass. The new owner has no native instance or dispatcher binding; production DESC10 remains denied.

claims.rx_owner: npu_cold_txdone_begin requires a finished RX-event owner with the matching retained plan and exact metadata readback.
claims.shared_packet: Claim progress is bounded to512 additional claims over a2560-claim prefix, and liveness checks compare the shared packet bitmap with the retained prefix plus the selected IDs.
claims.commit: Each store reservation retains a possible committed effect before the caller performs the store, and publication requires matching address, width and readback.
claims.ready: A ready byte of1 alone cannot make npu_cold_txdone_finish succeed.
claims.runtime: This validation proves that original native DESC10 executes successfully under authenticated allocator/caller setup.
claims.goal: This checkpoint completes the full NPU implementation and physical client acceptance.
